title: Understanding Bimodal Distribution
text: A bimodal distribution has two distinct peaks. Look at the spread of weights for each shape. Do you see two separate clusters of weights for any shape?

title: Mean Weight and Distribution
text: The mean weight gives an average value, but it doesn't show how the weights are spread out. Consider whether a single average can indicate multiple peaks in the data.

title: Analyzing the Plot
text: Does the plot show two distinct clusters of weights for any nugget shape?
